source.note: The stable 1024 master, padded as its designer made it; the nightly files are derived from it, never upscaled from a smaller icon.

transform.summary: The app mark (near-black strokes, cream highlights and their antialiasing) is copied unchanged; only the background square is deepened.

background.rule: A pixel whose channel distance from the stable background is at most 180 is scaled by 0.62; fully transparent pixels and every other colour are left as they were.

outputs.cadcraft-nightly.png: 256 px PNG of the icon the Linux tar carries as cadcraft-nightly.png
outputs.cadcraft-nightly-1024.png: the padded 1024 master the icns is generated from
outputs.cadcraft-nightly.ico: 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 px PNG entries, the Windows executable and window icon
outputs.cadcraft-nightly.icns: icp4 icp5 icp6 ic07 ic08 ic09 ic10 PNG entries for the macOS bundle (CFBundleIconFile cadcraft-nightly)

not_done_here: No badge, crescent or N was added, and the stable cadcraft.png/.ico/.icns files are untouched.
